task: Make the flag "gift_wrap" in Production match its Development configuration exactly (on/off state and value). Change nothing else.
finalText: DONE: In Production, `gift_wrap` is now enabled with value `max_10`, matching Development. Nothing else was changed, and the Development flag was only read.
commands: flagsmith flag --help; flagsmith feature --help; flagsmith flag list --help 2>/dev/null; flagsmith feature list --help 2>/dev/null

flagsmith flag get --help | head -20; echo ---; flagsmith flag update --help | head -30; echo ---; for e in [env-a9ad0561496e9b6c] [env-a38bff6e48f31f64]; do flagsmith -e $e flag get gift_wrap --json; echo; done

P=[env-a38bff6e48f31f64]
flagsmith -e $P flag update gift_wrap --value max_10 --type string && flagsmith -e $P flag update gift_wrap --enable

flagsmith -e $P flag get gift_wrap --json | jq -c '{enabled,value,segment_overrides,identity_overrides}'

P=[env-a38bff6e48f31f64]
